You will decide where and how security is built directly into the software development lifecycle (SDLC), so that engineering teams can ship features quickly without compromising safety. You will join our fast-growing, high-performing Security Engineering team. A world-class revenue platform depends on security that is designed in from the start, not bolted on at the end. As release velocity increases and AI-enabled features and AI-assisted development reshape how software gets built, the core challenge is building guardrails that are automated, scalable, and trusted by the developers who use them. On a day-to-day basis, you will: Architect scalable security controls for our web applications, microservices, and public and private APIs, including authentication and authorization frameworks, cryptography, input validation, and rate limiting. Automate security in the pipeline by embedding and tuning SAST, DAST, SCA, IAST, and secret scanning in CI/CD, using AI-assisted triage where it improves signal and speed. Lead threat modeling and design reviews with Product Managers and Engineering Architects during early feature design, including risks introduced by AI-enabled features. Drive remediation of complex vulnerabilities through deep-dive assessments, pen-test reviews, and bug bounty triage, partnering with engineering pods on root-cause fixes. Scale security awareness by developing developer-focused guidelines, delivering secure code training, and leading our Security Champions program across all product squads. This role lives at the heart of how we Lead From the Front: you'll automate what's manual, prototype guardrails before polishing them, and put AI to work wherever it makes our engineers safer and faster. And in the spirit of how we Make Your Mark, you'll build security systems engineered to scale and stand on their own, shaping the architecture of an enterprise SaaS platform trusted by the world's leading revenue organizations. You excel at translating complex software risks into actionable developer guidance, building automated guardrails that developers love, and establishing technical standards that scale across distributed engineering teams. You embody what we call Evidence Over Ego: you make decisions with data rather than instinct or seniority, and you give candid, constructive feedback that makes the work better. You bring systems thinking to everything you build, fixing root causes instead of patching symptoms, and you document your work so others can run with it. If you're looking for a role where you can set the technical direction for application security at scale, this is the right move. The engineers on our team are deeply curious, analytical problem-solvers who are highly collaborative and passionate about shipping secure software at velocity. The team Moves as One — one group grounded in mutual trust and shared ownership, where we name tension directly instead of working around it. And we are relentlessly Customer-Inspired: every decision traces back to a single question — does this make our customers more successful and their data safer? Deep technical expertise in web application security, API security (REST/GraphQL), OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, secure design patterns, and modern authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, JWT). Proficiency reading and writing code in modern languages used in SaaS architectures (e.g., Python, Go, Java, TypeScript/Node.js, or Ruby). Proven experience building and scaling automated AppSec tooling (SAST, DAST, SCA, container scanning) in enterprise CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins). Strong capability to run threat modeling frameworks (e.g., STRIDE) and conduct architectural security reviews across complex microservice ecosystems. Exceptional communication and developer-mentorship skills, with the ability to build trust and influence engineering pods without direct authority.
